name: NoSQL bypass -> mass assignment -> BFLA -> IDOR
goal: Walk from an authentication bypass into the admin data plane through privilege-model abuse.
preconditions: A JSON login endpoint backed by Mongo-style documents, plus a role-bearing user model.
impact: Unauthenticated or self-registered user reaches administrative functions and other tenants' objects.

steps.purpose: Enter as an existing (or synthetic) user without a password via $ne/$regex operators.
steps.on_success: Note the session shape; test which fields drive authorization.
steps.on_fail: Not Mongo or not JSON -> web/PHP type-juggling magic hash bypass; need usernames first -> web/Username enumeration login differential.

steps.purpose: Push role/isAdmin/permissions fields through register/profile-update to self-escalate.
steps.on_success: Decode the new session and diff privileges before/after.
steps.on_fail: Fields filtered on update -> try registration-time injection, PATCH vs PUT, or JSON vs form encoding (parser differential).

steps.purpose: With the escalated identity, hit admin-only functions directly to prove function-level authz is broken.
steps.on_success: Enumerate admin capabilities; pick the highest-value function (export, user management).
steps.on_fail: Function blocked -> header routing confusion elite/X-Original-URL routing confusion; endpoint unknown -> web/OpenAPI-Swagger spec exposed or field-suggestion enumeration.

steps.purpose: With any privileged identity, enumerate the object graph across tenants.
steps.on_success: Bulk-extract via elite/GraphQL alias amplification primitive if the API is GraphQL.
steps.on_fail: Sequential IDs blocked -> GUID leakage in exports/emails; document depth instead.

entry_points: JSON login bodies (grep JS for fetch(...login))
API docs and mobile builds revealing role fields
admin UIs reachable at non-obvious paths

recon.name: Schema echo diff
recon.how: Send unknown fields (role, isAdmin, tenant_id) and watch which echo back in responses or tokens.
recon.signal: Echoed unknown field = model accepts it somewhere.

recon.name: Operator probe matrix
recon.how: Try $ne, $regex, $where, $gt on login and search endpoints in JSON and URL-encoded forms.

recon.name: Role-model recovery
recon.how: Field-suggestion oracles and verbose errors reveal the role vocabulary (admin, staff, superuser).
recon.tooling: elite/GraphQL field suggestion enumeration or error mining
recon.signal: Role names you did not guess.

recon.name: Mobile API teardown
recon.how: Decompile the APK/IPA and grep API paths and role checks — older endpoints and hidden admin routes live here.

recon.name: Token audience check
recon.how: Decode tokens across services; tokens issued for one service often validate on siblings.

variants: role stored in cookie vs JWT vs server session
pivot_hints: admin function list -> pick export/report (bulk data)
combine with business-logic chain for monetary impact
